Arknights Endfield Gameplay Preview - SHOULD You PLAY It? Is It Worth it? 
In this Fextralife video, we'll be taking a look at Arknights Endfield, which is a new free to play 3D real-time strategy RPG developed by a Shanghai based Chinese video game developer. HYPERGRYPH. Arknight Endfield is releasing today, January 22nd and is available on PlayStation 5, PC and Mobile. In this video, we'll be taking a look at gameplay mechanics, combat, what you can expect when you dive into Arknights Endfield, and how it stands out among other heavy gacha titles out there.
